entities.summary: Geoffrey de Montbray, also known as Montbrai, Mowbray or Geoffrey of Coutances, was a Norman nobleman, secular prelate, warrior and administrator who was Bishop of Coutances from 1049 to 1093. He was an adviser of William the Conqueror. Robert de Mowbray was his heir and nephew.
